title: 2430. Maximum Deletions on a String

examples.explanation: - Delete the first 3 letters ("abc") since the next 3 letters are equal. Now, s = "abcdabc". - Delete all the letters. We used 2 operations so return 2. It can be proven that 2 is the maximum number of operations needed. Note that in the second operation we cannot delete "abc" again because the next occurrence of "abc" does not happen in the next 3 letters.

- Delete the first letter ("a") since the next letter is equal. Now, s = "aabaab". - Delete the first 3 letters ("aab") since the next 3 letters are equal. Now, s = "aab". - Delete the first letter ("a") since the next letter is equal. Now, s = "ab". - Delete all the letters. We used 4 operations so return 4. It can be proven that 4 is the maximum number of operations needed.
In each operation, we can delete the first letter of s.
